messages:
sana: FYI found a nasty repro with the Node onboarding sample: when a token rotation happens concurrently with a 429, the SDK retries and the webhook fires twice. attaching quick log snippet.

jordan: which header are you using for idempotency in the sample?
sana: `Idempotency-Key` header (camelcase). Node SDK's auth refresh path reconstructs the request and ends up dropping that header in some retry branches; so the retry loses the idempotency semantics. Logs: 

```
// timeline
client -> POST /hooks/outbound (auth about to rotate) -> 429
sdk refresh token (in-flight) -> retry POST /hooks/outbound (new token, header missing) -> 200
server accepted both requests
```

mike: that matches a bug I saw earlier where we clone only whitelisted headers during refresh. Not ideal.

olga: Oof. Parity note: Go SDK uses `x-rw-idempotency` by default, Python uses `Idempotency-Key`. We need one canonical header + normalization across SDKs. Suggest canonical `x-redwood-idempotency` (lowercase).

kevin: short term: two-pronged fix: 1) ensure token refresh preserves all headers (or at least idempotency header) in Node SDK, 2) add a small in-process retry-guard keyed by idempotency token to prevent re-sends for N ms. Patch behind feature flag `client_retry_guard`.
sana: I can open the Node PR for header-preserve + a prototype retryGuard (ttl map, default 3s). Will include unit tests and an e2e script that simulates token rotation + 429 and asserts only one side effect.
jordan: add telemetry event when a retry is suppressed so we can measure suppression rate. devex-bot: please file an incident if suppression > 0.5% over 5m window.

mike: note that in-process guard won't help multi-instance customers. Server-side idempotency is still required for correctness. Long-term server work: accept `x-redwood-idempotency`, and return `Idempotency-Cache: cached|new` so clients can log/cache decisions.
olga: I'll draft a tiny RFC for header canonicalization + `Idempotency-Cache` response header. Also add migration guide for SDKs.

kevin: we also need CI coverage in the sampleapp org: a flaky test in a matrix that rotates tokens mid-request. Add it to the sampleapp e2e pipeline.
sana: will add sampleapp README section with example usage, recommended header name, and a warning about payment endpoints. PR will reference issue #INC-987 for duplicate webhook deliveries.
jordan: reviewers: @mike @olga. Also update changelog and SDK migration notes.
devex-bot: Reminder: created issue INC-987: "Duplicate webhook deliveries on token rotation + 429". Linked PRs when ready. :bell:

kevin: one micro-optimization idea for retryGuard: store a fingerprint of body+idempotency-key (HMAC) to avoid attackers causing collisions. But keep simple for first patch.
mike: agree. Also ensure eviction by TTL and a hard cap to avoid memory exhaustion.
sana: thanks team. I'll push a draft PR and ping reviewers. Will include a small playground script to reproduce locally. :thumbsup:
